ddl.name: apikey
ddl.sql: CREATE TABLE "apikey" ("id" integer not null primary key, "configId" text not null, "name" text, "start" text, "referenceId" text not null, "prefix" text, "key" text not null, "refillInterval" integer, "refillAmount" integer, "lastRefillAt" date, "enabled" integer, "rateLimitEnabled" integer, "rateLimitTimeWindow" integer, "rateLimitMax" integer, "requestCount" integer, "remaining" integer, "lastRequest" date, "stored_expiry" integer references "user" ("id") on delete cascade, "createdAt" date not null, "updatedAt" date not null, "permissions" text, "metadata" text)
